The United States spends about one trillion dollars a year on its military.

In 2025, that was more than the next six countries combined: China, Russia, Germany, India, the UK and Ukraine.

One F-35 fighter jet costs more than a thousand years of a typical American household's income.

And the Pentagon has failed its audit eight times in a row.

So where does the trillion actually go? We opened the file. The full video is on the channel: FILE zero zero one.
